subject: Help needed — duplicate PO token created during vendor intake (spend cap locked)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@veridian-supply.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: veridian.billing@veridian-supply.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake completed — PO token duplication and spend cap lock

Hi Naomi,

We finished the intake form and uploaded the documents, but our vendor portal shows we received two different PO tokens for the same onboarding: POC-2025-9981 and POC-2025-9981-1. The second token appears to be a duplicate and it set our spend cap to $0 while the original token shows the expected provisional cap. As a result, our provisioning API is returning a spend-cap-locked error and we can't finish registration.

Attached: veridian_onboard_form.pdf and po_token_snapshot.png.

Can someone on your side confirm which token is active and temporarily lift the spend cap so we can complete the last steps? This is blocking our provisioning window for this week.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Veridian Supply Co.
liam@veridian-supply.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@veridian-supply.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake completed — PO token duplication and spend cap lock

Thanks for the heads up, Liam — sorry for the friction. I copied Monica (Procurement Ops) and Marcus (Finance). We will triage this immediately.

Quick answers up front:
- We will identify which PO token is canonical and retire the duplicate.
- If needed, we can open a temporary spend-cap override for provisioning while we reconcile.

Monica / Marcus — can you confirm the canonical PO token for Veridian based on the intake form (attached) and the token snapshot? I gave the portal ticket REQ-8821 a quick look; it shows both tokens created within the same minute which suggests a race condition in the intake job.

Liam — could you confirm whether any invoices were submitted against either token? If not, we should be able to retire the duplicate safely.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor intake completed — PO token duplication and spend cap lock

Forwarding logs and quick plan.

-- Forwarded message --
From: System Intake <no-reply@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:58:12 -07:00
Subject: New intake processed: Veridian Supply Co.

Payload snippet attached: token-mapping.csv shows two entries for onboarding_id=ONB-7742 with tokens POC-2025-9981 and POC-2025-9981-1.

Action plan (proposed):
1) David to re-run the intake reconciliation job for ONB-7742 with dedupe flag; that should keep the earliest token as canonical and reassign any metadata.
2) Marcus to issue a temporary spend cap override (provisioning-only) for 24 hours to allow Veridian to finish setup.
3) Naomi to confirm with Liam that no invoices exist on either token.
4) If all clear, remove the duplicate token and update REQ-8821 with the final mapping and audit note.

David — can you run the job and post the job id here when done?

Thanks,
Monica
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@veridian-supply.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: veridian.billing@veridian-supply.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake completed — PO token duplication and spend cap lock

Hi Naomi / team,

No invoices have been submitted yet on either token — we stopped after the spend-cap error. I attached an export of our provisioning logs; the error code is SPEND_LOCK_403 when we call /v1/provision.

We appreciate a temporary override — we have a scheduled provisioning window tomorrow morning at 10:00 PT. ETA is important for us.

Attachments: token-mapping.csv (export), provisioning-error-20250701.log

— Liam
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake completed — PO token duplication and spend cap lock

Job completed: intake-reconcile ONB-7742 (job id: JR-5542). Summary:
- Canonical token selected: POC-2025-9981 (earliest created).
- POC-2025-9981-1 marked as duplicate and soft-retired (audit flag set).
- Metadata merged; no invoice records were present.

Marcus — I left a note on REQ-8821 requesting a 12-hour provisioning override only. Marcus, can you approve the override so we can unblock their provisioning window at 10:00 PT today? If you prefer 24h we can extend.

Naomi / Liam — please confirm on your side that the portal shows only POC-2025-9981 and that the error is resolved after Marcus issues the override. I will keep the soft-retired token in the audit table for 90 days before permanent deletion.

Thanks,
David Kim
Vendor Onboarding Engineer
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake completed — PO token duplication and spend cap lock

Override approved and live: OV-4021 (provisioning-only, 12 hours). I added a note: "Temporary override for Veridian onboarding while duplicate token removed; revoke at expiry unless escalated." REQ-8821 updated with OV-4021 and audit link.

Naomi — can you ask Veridian to retry provisioning and confirm success? If we see any invoice activity against POC-2025-9981-1 during the 12h window, escalate to finance for hold reversal.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Finance Ops Analyst
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@veridian-supply.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 14:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake completed — PO token duplication and spend cap lock

Liam — Marcus has pushed a 12-hour provisioning override (OV-4021). David reconciled and retired the duplicate token. Please retry your provisioning now and let us know the result. If you still hit SPEND_LOCK_403, send the provisioning request headers and timestamp and we will trace it.

If successful, we'll close REQ-8821 and I'll follow up with a short post-mortem on the intake race condition and a proposed fix for the dedupe window.

Thanks — Naomi
